messages:
max: Heads-up — while triaging a staging job I saw `API_KEY_STAGING` printed in startup logs. Only a few lines, not full payload. Should we rotate? who can approve immediate rotation? cc @sara @toni
sara: can you paste the log snippet? don't share key, mask it.
max: here's the snippet (masked):
```text
[2026-03-15T02:23:12Z] INFO startup: loaded env API_KEY_STAGING=sk_live_ABC123...def
[2026-03-15T02:23:12Z] INFO auth: using kms key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/abcd
```
security-bot: Incident created INC-2026-78 — staging key exposure. https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-78 :rotating_light:
toni: yes rotate immediately. If it's a staging key, rotation window is same-day. Who will rotate? ops or dev?
max: I can rotate and update deploy; need confirmation on KMS grants — do we need to rewrap or create a new CMK? Current CMK is customer-managed but used across envs.
sara: do NOT create a new CMK. Rotate the secret in Vault/Secret Manager and update service references. Only change CMK policy if there's evidence CMK key material leaked.
toni: approve rotation by max. @max proceed. Keep me posted.
max: plan: 1) create new secret in Vault with limited scope 2) deploy to staging, smoke test 3) revoke old secret and capture audit events 4) file runbook update. ETA ~1h.
sara: also add a log-redaction regex to runtime logging middleware: `(?i)(api_key|secret|token)=\S+` -> `$1=[REDACTED]`. I'll open a quick PR.
ops: HSM is prod-only, no HSM import needed for this staging secret. Confirmed.
sara: also run a grep across logs for `sk_live_` over last 7 days and rotate any hits. Max, can you take that?
max: running search now, found two older masked prints. Rotated both secrets and updated audit. Posting deploy links and PR after merge.
security-bot: Incident INC-2026-78 status changed to mitigated by max.
toni: thanks. please add 'env-var redaction' to on-call checklist and add a short blameless postmortem.
sara: added to checklist and created a short postmortem template. :white_check_mark:
max: closing thread, will attach PRs and the postmortem doc to the incident.
